metadata.method: Minimum instantaneous fleet, cumulative run (from 1s) and trailing 60s arithmetic means, computed on every positive simulation step; all private/service cars included, including stopped cars. Headless runs skip car matrix writes only; buses/trams and movement continue. No speed inflation, metric clamping, vehicle filtering, recovery moves, or red overrides.
metadata.demand: Persistent inbound and homeward trips. High congestion assigns 92% of inbound trip intents to the actual (0,0) core junction; rush hour assigns 55% to real core junctions. A trip ends only on physical non-internal crossing of a real junction. This repairs the previous every-junction inward attraction; results are not claimed to use the same never-ending circling trajectories.
metadata.assignmentCounters: Inbound/central assignment counts include a next leg planned at the home approach; completed trips/returns count physical arrivals only.
metadata.finiteScope: These deterministic checks validate the stated durations/configurations, not an unlimited guarantee for every possible future state or configuration.
metadata.rendererIntegrationNote: A render-only multi-material GLB primitive-group import fix was added after the timed runs and verified by the real-GLB traffic startup/reset integration test. Movement and speed calculations are unchanged.
